objectives.text: Part 120 regulates SBA's financial assistance to small businesses under its general business loan programs (7(a) loans), microloan demonstration loan program (Microloans), and development company program (504 loans).

citations.quote: This part regulates SBA's financial assistance to small businesses under its general business loan programs (“7(a) loans”) authorized by section 7(a) of the Small Business Act (“the Act”), 15 U.S.C. 636(a), its microloan demonstration loan program (“Microloans”) authorized by section 7(m) of the Act, 15 U.S.C. 636(m), and its development company program (“504 loans”) authorized by Title V of the Small Business Investment Act, 15 U.S.C. 695 to 697f (“Title V”).

objectives.text: 7(a) loans provide financing for general business purposes.

citations.quote: 7(a) loans provide financing for general business purposes

objectives.text: 504 Projects require long-term fixed-asset financing for small businesses provided by a CDC.

citations.quote: Projects involving 504 loans require long-term fixed-asset financing for small businesses.

objectives.text: The purpose of the ARC Loan Program is to enable SBA to guarantee certain loans to viable small businesses experiencing immediate financial hardship.

citations.quote: The purpose of the ARC Loan Program is to enable SBA to guarantee certain loans to viable small businesses that are experiencing immediate financial hardship.

objectives.text: Purpose of the First Lien Position 504 Loan Pool Program is to temporarily provide a federal guarantee for Pools of First Lien Position 504 Loans to facilitate sale and increase liquidity so lenders can fund more such loans.

citations.quote: The purpose of the Program is to temporarily provide a federal guarantee for Pools of First Lien Position 504 Loans to facilitate the sale of such loans and increase the liquidity of the lenders holding the loans so that the lenders can use the sale proceeds to fund more such loans.

objectives.text: EWCP guarantees short-term working capital loans made to exporters; proceeds only to finance export transactions.

citations.quote: Under the EWCP, SBA guarantees short-term working capital loans made by participating lenders to exporters (section 7(a)(14) of the Act).

obligations.action: purchase its portion of the outstanding balance of a guaranteed loan
obligations.trigger: If the small business defaults on the loan, upon demand by the Lender and subject to specific conditions

citations.quote: If the small business defaults on the loan, SBA's guarantee requires SBA to purchase its portion of the outstanding balance, upon demand by the Lender and subject to specific conditions.

obligations.action: provide business loan assistance only to applicants for whom desired credit is not otherwise available on reasonable terms from non-Federal, non-State, and non-local government sources

citations.quote: SBA provides business loan assistance only to applicants for whom the desired credit is not otherwise available on reasonable terms from non-Federal, non-State, and non-local government sources.

obligations.action: certify or otherwise show that the desired credit is unavailable to the applicant on reasonable terms and conditions from non-Federal, non-State, and non-local government sources without SBA assistance

citations.quote: SBA requires the Lender or CDC to certify or otherwise show that the desired credit is unavailable to the applicant on reasonable terms and conditions from non-Federal, non-State, and non-local government sources without SBA assistance

obligations.action: be creditworthy

citations.quote: The applicant (including an Operating Company) must be creditworthy.

obligations.action: be so sound as to reasonably assure repayment

citations.quote: Loans must be so sound as to reasonably assure repayment.

obligations.action: use appropriate and prudent generally acceptable commercial credit analysis processes and procedures consistent with those used for their similarly-sized, non-SBA guaranteed commercial loans

citations.quote: Lenders and CDCs must use appropriate and prudent generally acceptable commercial credit analysis processes and procedures consistent with those used for their similarly-sized, non-SBA guaranteed commercial loans.

obligations.action: use a business credit scoring model

citations.quote: Lenders, CDCs, and SBA may use a business credit scoring model.

obligations.actor: aggregate SBA portions of all loans to a single Borrower (including affiliates)
obligations.action: exceed a guaranty amount of $3,750,000
obligations.threshold: $3,750,000 guaranty amount, including affiliates as defined in § 121.301(f)
exceptions: except as otherwise authorized by statute for a specific program

citations.quote: The aggregate amount of the SBA portions of all loans to a single Borrower, including the Borrower's affiliates as defined in § 121.301(f) of this chapter, must not exceed a guaranty amount of $3,750,000, except as otherwise authorized by statute for a specific program.

obligations.action: not exceed maximum loan amount of $5,000,000

citations.quote: The maximum loan amount for any one 7(a) loan is $5,000,000.

obligations.action: exceed the applicable percentage established in section 7(a) of the Act
obligations.threshold: $150,000 or less: max 85%; more than $150,000: max 75%
exceptions: except as otherwise authorized by law

citations.quote: SBA's guarantee percentage must not exceed the applicable percentage established in section 7(a) of the Act.
Loans of $150,000 or less may receive a maximum guaranty of 85 percent. Loans more than $150,000 may receive a maximum guaranty of 75 percent, except as otherwise authorized by law.

obligations.action: receive a guaranty of 90 percent, not to exceed $4,500,000
obligations.threshold: 90 percent, not to exceed $4,500,000; maximum loan $5,000,000

citations.quote: EWCP loans shall receive a guaranty of 90 percent, not to exceed $4,500,000.

obligations.action: be used only to finance export transactions

citations.quote: Proceeds can be used only to finance export transactions.

obligations.action: make or guarantee loans to finance small general contractors to construct or rehabilitate residential or commercial property for resale
exceptions: provides an exception under specified conditions to the general rule against financing investment property

citations.quote: Under section 7(a)(9) of the Act, SBA may make or guarantee loans to finance small general contractors to construct or rehabilitate residential or commercial property for resale.

obligations.action: include one or more Third Party Loans totaling at least as much as the 504 loan
obligations.threshold: at least as much as the 504 loan; at least 50% of total project cost if borrower operated two years or less or single/limited purpose asset

citations.quote: A Project financing must include one or more Third Party Loans totaling at least as much as the 504 loan.
However, the Third Party Loans must total at least 50 percent of the total cost of the Project if:

obligations.action: improve the lien position of the Lender on the pre-existing debt
obligations.trigger: when consolidation of existing debt on the Project Property is included
exceptions: unless the debt is a previous Third-Party Loan

citations.quote: The consolidation must not improve the lien position of the Lender on the pre-existing debt, unless the debt is a previous Third-Party Loan.

obligations.action: generally not exceed 40 percent of total Project cost plus 100 percent of eligible administrative costs
obligations.threshold: 40% of total Project cost + 100% eligible admin costs; up to 50% for good cause; no more than 50% of eligible Project costs from Federal sources
exceptions: For good cause shown, SBA may authorize an increase in the percentage of Project costs covered up to 50 percent

citations.quote: Generally, a 504 loan may not exceed 40 percent of total Project cost plus 100 percent of eligible administrative costs. For good cause shown, SBA may authorize an increase in the percentage of Project costs covered up to 50 percent. No more than 50 percent of eligible Project costs can be from Federal sources, whether received directly or indirectly through an intermediary.

obligations.action: be less than $25,000

citations.quote: A 504 loan must not be less than $25,000.

obligations.action: be limited to the amounts enumerated ($5,000,000 outstanding balance per Borrower and affiliates; $5,500,000 per Project for specified categories)
obligations.threshold: $5,000,000 outstanding balance; $5,500,000 per Project for small manufacturers/energy reduction/renewable energy

citations.quote: 504 loan amounts shall be limited to:

obligations.actor: interest rate of the 504 Loan and the Debenture
obligations.action: be set by the SBA and approved by the Secretary of the Treasury

citations.quote: The interest rate of the 504 Loan and the Debenture which funds it is set by the SBA and approved by the Secretary of the Treasury.

obligations.action: publish in the Federal Register the available maturities for a 504 loan and the Debenture that funds it

citations.quote: From time to time, SBA will publish in the Federal Register the available maturities for a 504 loan and the Debenture that funds it.

obligations.action: guarantee not more than $3,000,000,000 of pools under this authority

citations.quote: The Program's authorization expires on September 23, 2012 and the Administrator may guarantee not more than $3,000,000,000 of pools under this authority pursuant to section 503(c)(B)(iii) of the Recovery Act, as amended by section 1119 of the Small Business Jobs Act of 2010.

definitions.definition: SBA's general business loan programs authorized by section 7(a) of the Small Business Act, providing financing for general business purposes; may be a direct loan, immediate participation loan, or guaranteed (deferred participation) loan.

citations.quote: general business loan programs (“7(a) loans”) authorized by section 7(a) of the Small Business Act (“the Act”), 15 U.S.C. 636(a)

definitions.definition: SBA loans and loan guarantees to non-profit Intermediaries that make short-term loans up to $50,000 to eligible small businesses for general business purposes, except payment of personal debts.

citations.quote: SBA makes loans and loan guarantees to non-profit Intermediaries that make short-term loans up to $50,000 to eligible small businesses for general business purposes, except payment of personal debts.

definitions.definition: Development company program under Title V; final portion of long-term fixed-asset financing provided by a CDC with a 504 loan made from proceeds of a Debenture issued by the CDC, guaranteed 100 percent by SBA.

citations.quote: A Certified Development Company (CDC) provides the final portion of this financing with a 504 loan made from the proceeds of a Debenture issued by the CDC, guaranteed 100 percent by SBA (with the full faith and credit of the United States), and sold to investors.

definitions.definition: A loan by which SBA guarantees a portion of a loan made by a Lender, initiated by a Lender applying under a blanket guarantee agreement; Lender funds and services the loan.

citations.quote: A guaranteed loan (deferred participation) by which SBA guarantees a portion of a loan made by a Lender.

definitions.definition: the production and payment associated with a sale of goods or services to a foreign buyer

citations.quote: An export transaction is the production and payment associated with a sale of goods or services to a foreign buyer.

definitions.definition: For purposes of § 120.842, a 504 loan in an amount that is not more than $500,000 and which is underwritten, approved, closed and serviced using the authorities set forth in this section.

citations.quote: an ALP Express Loan means a 504 loan in an amount that is not more than $500,000 and which is underwritten, approved, closed and serviced using the authorities set forth in this section.

definitions.definition: only work done on-site to the structure, utility connections and landscaping

citations.quote: “Construct” and “rehabilitate” mean only work done on-site to the structure, utility connections and landscaping.

definitions.definition: A program that finances eligible small businesses' short-term, revolving and non-revolving working-capital needs, governed by the 7(a) loan program regulations.

citations.quote: CapLines finances eligible small businesses' short-term, revolving and non-revolving working-capital needs.

definitions.definition: Loans made under the ARC Loan Program, subject to the requirements set forth in this Part for 7(a) loans except as noted in § 120.398.

citations.quote: Loans made under this loan program are referred to as ARC Loans and are subject to the requirements set forth in this Part for 7(a) loans except as noted in this section.

definitions.definition: (undefined here) — entity that provides the final portion of 504 financing and issues the Debenture.

citations.quote: A Certified Development Company (CDC) provides the final portion of this financing

definitions.definition: Qualified CDCs designated by SBA under the Premier Certified Lenders Program with delegated increased authority to process, close, service, and liquidate 504 loans.

citations.quote: Under the PCLP, SBA designates qualified CDCs as PCLP CDCs and delegates to them increased authority to process, close, service, and liquidate 504 loans.

definitions.definition: A loan comprising the balance of 504 Project financing, collateralized by a first lien on the Project property.

citations.quote: A Third Party Loan comprising the balance of the financing, collateralized by a first lien on the Project property (see § 120.920).

definitions.definition: (undefined here) — instrument issued by the CDC, guaranteed 100 percent by SBA, and sold to Underwriters who form Debenture Pools.

citations.quote: The Debenture is guaranteed 100 percent by SBA (with the full faith and credit of the United States), and sold to Underwriters who form Debenture Pools.

definitions.definition: (undefined here) — company whose loan applies to the loan limit of both it and the Operating Company.

citations.quote: The amount of any loan received by an Eligible Passive Company applies to the loan limit of both the Eligible Passive Company and the Operating Company.

definitions.definition: (undefined here) — entity included as applicant that must be creditworthy.

citations.quote: The applicant (including an Operating Company) must be creditworthy.

definitions.definition: NAICS Codes 31-33 with all production facilities located in the United States (for purposes of the $5,500,000 per-Project 504 lending limit).

citations.quote: Small Manufacturers (NAICS Codes 31-33) with all production facilities located in the United States

definitions.term: First Lien Position 504 Loans / Pool Certificates
definitions.definition: (undefined here) — loans whose portions comprise Pools for which SBA guarantees Pool Certificates sold to Pool Investors under the Recovery Act Program.

citations.quote: SBA establishes the Program to authorize an entity to apply for SBA's guarantee of Pools comprised of portions of First Lien Position 504 Loans backing Pool Certificates to be sold to Pool Investors.

citations.quote: Regulations specific to 7(a) loans are found in subpart B of this part.
Regulations specific to these loans are found in subpart G of this part.
The regulations specific to these loans are found in subpart H of this part.

interactions.description: 504 lending limit of $5,000,000 applies where a public policy goal enumerated in § 120.862(b) applies to the Project.

citations.quote: if one or more of the public policy goals enumerated in § 120.862(b) applies to the Project

interactions.description: CapLines maximum guaranteed and loan amounts are the same as other 7(a) loans as stated in § 120.151.

citations.quote: The maximum guaranteed amount and the maximum loan amount are the same under CapLines as other 7(a) loans, as stated in § 120.151.

notes: Several provisions in this snapshot are facially expired or time-limited but remain in the codified text: § 120.1701 states 'The Program's authorization expires on September 23, 2012' yet is presented as live text; extracted as written per fidelity rule. § 120.398 (ARC Loan Program) reflects legacy Recovery Act programs. Section 7(a) statutory guarantee percentage (§ 120.210) both references 'the applicable percentage established in section 7(a) of the Act' and states specific percentages (85%/75%) — potential dependence on external statute preserved without resolution. The $3,750,000 aggregate guaranty limit (§ 120.151) and the $5,000,000 max 7(a) loan / guarantee percentages coexist; cross-program divergences (differing $ limits and guarantee percentages across 7(a), EWCP, 504) preserved as-is, not reconciled.
